title: Other suite consumers (Incanter, Familiar, Solomon, Mystery, Astral)
keyFindings: The suite is already graph-native: Astrographer (reference/fact/embed graph, astrographer.md §4.2), Zodiac (pre-graphing + vector-embedding, zodiac.md §4.2), and Incanter (document graph + graph-tension hybrid, incanter.md §4.4/§4.8) are all graphical RAG engines, so Graph RAG is a completion/exposure task, not a foreign adoption.

The highest-value MUST work is graph-enhanced retrieval over Astrographer's reference graph (topological resolution of reference→fact, per the DAG-RAG research), which directly enables relationship-aware, multi-hop answers and is D2/D4-compliant.

Explainability/trace is the strongest governance fit: Astrographer's consistency model (astrographer.md §4.2.3) and Zodiac's sourceCrawlId/stale provenance (zodiac.md §4.3.2) already track provenance; adding a trace path to RAG results is a small, high-value SHOULD.
Incanter's concrete gaps are engine-boundary handoffs, not new Graph RAG techniques: the BM25 lexical leg (GAP-2, parked D5) and the multi-query fan-out (GAP-1) — both recorded in docs/defects.md.

Familiar and Astral are consumers/hosts, not Graph RAG engines: Familiar inherits the graph layer through Astrographer's ragQuery (familiar.md §4.3.1/§4.3.3); Astral serves the graphs Astrographer produces (astral.md §4.1), with its relevant enhancement being the agent-facing reachability surface (GAP-5).

Solomon cross-instance ranking and Mystery crosslink modeling are PARKED: Solomon's Phase-1 keeps cross-peer ordering unpinned (solomon.md §7.4), and Mystery's spec is absent (docs/pending.md #12) — both defer until their contracts finalize.
summary: Graph RAG is not a foreign technique for the Auspicion Suite — Astrographer, Zodiac, and Incanter are already graphical RAG engines over knowledge-graph-shaped data. The MUST work is completing graph-enhanced retrieval over Astrographer's reference graph; the SHOULD work is an explainability/trace surface on RAG results and the Incanter engine-boundary gaps (lexical leg, multi-query fan-out). The expensive global techniques (community summaries, dynamic graph query generation) and the deferred consumers (Solomon ranking, Mystery crosslinks) stay PARKED for D2 cost reasons and spec-absence reasons.
